prompt: Verification passed with no blockers. I explicitly approve completion of the research and closure of its configured work item.

assertions.name: resolves_exact_resources
assertions.description: Resolves exact target resources (work items, documents) without guessing

assertions.name: discovers_allowed_transitions
assertions.description: Queries or discovers allowed transitions rather than assuming target states

assertions.name: applies_provider_rules
assertions.description: Applies configured provider-specific closure rules (Jira/Confluence conventions)

assertions.name: records_final_output_reference
assertions.description: Records a reference to the exact final research output/document

assertions.name: mutates_only_after_approval
assertions.description: Performs external mutations only after receiving explicit approval

assertions.name: verifies_final_status
assertions.description: Reads back and verifies final work item status after mutation
